basis: Complete operator-supplied report from the pinned offline evaluation runner and unchanged 1200-image benchmark.

deployment_conditions.scope: Calibrated model score on the reviewed image benchmark; no video probability or deployment-wide confidence claim.

limitations: Same existing 1200-image benchmark replayed on Linux; not 1200 additional independent observations.
Runtime selected for deployment before this test; 24 Linux scores have already been inspected.
The original Windows evaluation and earlier failed 200-image test remain unchanged.
Intervals are descriptive runtime checks on the reused benchmark, not a new independent hypothesis-test guarantee.
Publisher labels and prompt/hash screens do not prove complete training-image or scene independence.
Balanced benchmark model scores do not establish confidence for live-upload prevalence or video-level results.
No inference that the original numerical-equivalence tolerance passed; drift is reported separately.
